approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Parliamentary Departments.
The funding would cover about seven-twelfths of the estimated annual appropriations for 2022-23, plus any Budget measures for that year.
The remaining five-twelfths, minus Budget measures, would be provided by a separate supply bill to ensure adequate funds for the early part of the financial year.
The bill proposes appropriations from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Parliamentary Departments.
The bill sets the appropriation amount at about seven-twelfths of the estimated 2022-23 annual appropriations, plus Budget measures.
The bill separates these appropriations from those for ordinary annual services, as required by the Constitution.
The Parliamentary Departments and their expenditure are affected.

The Appropriation (Parliamentary Departments) Bill (No. 1) 2022-2023 seeks $171 million for the last seven months of the financial year for four parliamentary departments, including $10.3 million for enhanced security infrastructure at Parliament House.
